behavior_checks.behavior: Backtest keeps all earlier records per signature and pairs a current failure with an earlier confirmed recurrence when the immediately previous same-signature record is only possible.
Possible recurrence pairs remain reported separately and excluded from the headline ERR.
An explicitly enabled recurrence gate with a configured max_error_recurrence_rate is evaluated by backtest and returns recurrence_gate_failed with exit 5 when tripped.
Invalid enabled gate configuration remains fail-closed with a line-specific relia.yaml reference.

redaction_posture.notes: Task-run evidence remains internal and contains only synthetic test references and repo-relative paths.
